sloka: न कच्चिद्भगवन् किञ्चित्पूर्ववृत्तमिदं मयि ।दृश्यते विकृतं येन विक्रियन्ते तपस्विन: ॥ २.११६.५॥
transliteration: na kaccidbhagavan kiñcitpūrvavṛttamidaṁ mayi ।dṛśyate vikṛtaṁ yena vikriyante tapasvina: ॥ 2.116.5॥

translations.english: O revered sire, have you seen any change in my conduct? For what reason are the sages looking perturbed?
